products.halos-off-hoodie.pitch: tiny horns stitched on the hood.
products.halos-off-hoodie.description: A heavy, soft navy hoodie that looks perfectly innocent from the front. Pull the hood up and two small horns appear. The logo sits where the drawstrings meet, so the secret is always close to your chest.
products.nice-guy-long-story-tee.pitch: red shadow peeking from the pocket.
products.nice-guy-long-story-tee.descrip: A cream cotton tee with one small detail: a horned shadow looking out of the chest pocket. Most people will not notice it. The ones who do will ask, and the answer is always "long story".
products.horns-down-cap.description: A navy six-panel cap with the shadow stitched tone on tone, so it only shows when the light hits it. One size, with an adjustable strap. Quiet from far away, curious up close.
products.two-sides-socks.pitch: one angelic pair, one very red.
products.two-sides-socks.description: Two pairs in one set: a calm cream pair and a very red one. Wear the side that fits the day, or mix them and let people guess. Either way, only your shoes know.
products.secret-no-1.pitch: warm amber, a little smoke. signature.
products.secret-no-1.description: The signature scent of the house. Warm amber opens first, friendly and easy to like. A thin line of smoke arrives later and stays, like something you decided not to say.
products.sweet-nothing.pitch: vanilla and pink pepper. sweet first, then something else.
products.sweet-nothing.description: Soft vanilla on the surface, pink pepper underneath. It starts sweet and polite, then turns a little sharp when people come closer. Made for a second impression.
products.after-midnight.pitch: oud and leather. for the hours nobody asks about.
products.after-midnight.description: Deep oud wrapped in dark leather. It is slow, calm and hard to read, and it gets better the later it is. A scent for the part of the night that stays between you and the moon.
products.morning-alibi.pitch: clean citrus and musk. you were home.
products.morning-alibi.description: Bright citrus and clean musk, fresh as an open window. It smells like eight hours of sleep and a clear conscience. Nobody will ask where you were.
products.little-devil-earbuds.pitch: horned pocket case. nobody knows what is playing.
products.little-devil-earbuds.descriptio: Wireless earbuds in a small pocket case with two horns on top. It looks like a toy on the desk. What plays inside is between you and the horns. Your playlist stays your business.
products.hot-head-power-bank.description: A slim navy power bank with the face on the front and four small lights that tell you how much is left. It sits in your pocket and says nothing. The only one who knows how long the night will be.
products.night-shift-lamp.pitch: one dial, angel white to devil red.
products.night-shift-lamp.description: A small desk lamp with one dial. Turn it one way for clean white light to work by. Turn it the other way and the room goes deep red, and the lamp grows horns on the wall.
products.the-tail-cable.description: A braided red charging cable that ends in a pointed tail tip. It is the one cable on the desk nobody takes by mistake. Leave it out: it looks like something is hiding behind the laptop.
home.hero.lede1: One name, three sides. Clothes, scents and gadgets that look sweet and keep something back.
home.hero.lede2: Look closer. Everything here has a little devil behind it.
home.hero.ring: there is more to it ✦ keep scrolling ✦ there is more to it ✦ keep going ✦
home.trio.title: three sides of the same secret.
home.mani.title: one name. more than it shows.
home.mani.text: The cute devil is the nice one in the room, with a little shadow behind him. So we make things the same way: clothes with a wink, scents that keep a secret, gadgets with a hidden side. Charming at first look. More, the longer you stay.
home.feat.title: fresh from the shadows
home.wear.title: dress like you know something.
home.wear.lede: Clean from across the room. Up close there is always a small detail: horns stitched on a hood, a shadow peeking from a pocket.
home.scent.title: smell like a secret.
home.scent.lede: Amber and smoke. Vanilla, then pink pepper. Oud and leather for the late hours. The first note is the polite one.
home.scent.ring: amber ✦ smoke ✦ vanilla ✦ pink pepper ✦ oud ✦ leather ✦ citrus ✦ musk ✦

story.head.title: one name. two sides.
story.head.lede: A friendly face, and a shadow with horns right behind it. That is the logo, and it is also the whole idea.
story.idea.title: nice is only half of it.
story.idea.text: Everybody has the side they show and the side they keep. We like both. So every piece here is easy to like at first look, and keeps one small thing for later: a detail, a note, a feature you find on the second day. The devil is just a wink. The secret is the point.
story.sides.title: what you see. what you find.
story.sides.item4: Horns stitched where you do not look first.
story.bio.text1: Mohamed Khedr is an engineer and an educator. He builds smart devices, and he teaches.
story.bio.text2: Engineers like things that work. Teachers like things that make sense. The Cute Devil is where those two meet a third habit of his: he simply likes nice things.
story.bio.text3: So the brand has one rule. He makes the things he actually wants to own. If he would not wear it, wear it out or keep it on his desk, it does not get the name.
story.values.title: five small promises.
story.values.text1: It should be easy to like at first look. No explaining needed.
story.values.text2: Every piece keeps one detail for later. Finding it is half the fun.
story.values.text3: Wear, scent, tech. Different things, the same character in each.
story.values.text4: You order by WhatsApp and the rest is sorted in the chat. No account needed.
story.values.text5: No invented reviews, no fake numbers. Sample prices are marked as samples.
story.close.title: now you know half.
story.close.text: The other half is in the shop.

faq.theSite.title: The site
faq.howOrderingWorks.a1: Add what you like to the bag, open the checkout and type your name and your city and country. The site prepares a WhatsApp message with your items and an order reference.
faq.howOrderingWorks.a2: WhatsApp opens with that message ready. You press send, and we reply in the same chat to confirm availability, the final price, delivery and payment. Your order is confirmed only in that conversation.
faq.whyWhatsapp.a1: Because the shop is new and we want to talk every order through with you. A chat lets us confirm stock, price and delivery with you directly before any money moves.
faq.whyWhatsapp.a2: WhatsApp is operated by a third party under its own terms. If you would rather not use it, the contact page and the legal notice list the other ways to reach us.
faq.doINeedAnAccount.a: No. The site has no accounts and no login. Your bag is saved in your own browser, on your own device.
faq.arePricesFinal.a: Not yet. The prices on the site are samples that show the range we are aiming for. The final price, with any taxes and delivery cost, is the one we confirm to you in the WhatsApp conversation.
faq.sampleBadge.a1: You will see this next to every price: Sample
faq.sampleBadge.a2: It means the price is an example, not an offer. Totals in the bag are estimates based on those sample prices. Nothing is charged on the site.
faq.payment.a1: Not on this website. It takes no payment and never asks for card details. We agree the payment method with you in the chat when we confirm your order. Accepted methods: [PAYMENT METHODS].
faq.payment.a2: Please never type card numbers into a chat message.
faq.delivery.q: Where do you deliver, and how long does it take?
faq.delivery.a1: We plan to deliver in Spain, across the European Union and in the United Arab Emirates. Delivery times and costs are to be confirmed: [TO BE CONFIRMED]. For now we quote both for your address in the chat, before you pay.
faq.delivery.a2: See shipping and returns for the details.
faq.sizes.q: How do I choose a size?
faq.sizes.a1: Products that come in sizes show the options on the product page, and you pick one before adding to the bag.
faq.sizes.a2: A full size guide is to be confirmed: [TO BE CONFIRMED]. Until then, ask us on WhatsApp for the measurements of any piece and we will help you choose.
faq.returns.a1: Start by messaging us on WhatsApp with your order reference, before sending anything back. We reply with the next steps.
faq.returns.a2: Consumers in the European Union generally have a legal period to change their mind on distance purchases, with some exceptions. The exact conditions are being finalised and are set out on the shipping and returns page.
faq.colourTheme.q: How do I change the colour theme?
faq.colourTheme.a1: Use the four round colour dots at the top of the page (inside the menu on phones) or in the footer. There are four looks: cream, red, purple and blue.
faq.colourTheme.a2: Your choice is saved in your browser so the site looks the same next time.
faq.whatDoYouStore.q: What does the site remember about me?
faq.whatDoYouStore.a1: Three things, all kept on your device: your colour theme, your language and your bag. No tracking cookies, no advertising cookies, no third-party scripts.
faq.whatDoYouStore.a2: You can erase all three on the cookies and storage page.
faq.stillCurious.q: My question is not here. Now what?
faq.stillCurious.a: Then ask it. Message us by WhatsApp on +34 622 20 99 35 or use the contact page. We answer there.

shipping.callout.text: Delivery regions, times, costs and return conditions on this page are to be confirmed. We confirm the details for your order in the WhatsApp conversation before you pay.
shipping.howItWorks.text1: There is no automatic shipping calculator on this website. When you send an order request through WhatsApp, we reply with the delivery cost and an estimated delivery time for your address. You see both before you pay anything.
shipping.howItWorks.text2: Once your order is confirmed and paid, we prepare it and send you the tracking details, where the carrier provides them, in the same conversation.
shipping.regions.text1: We plan to deliver to the regions below. Times and costs are not final yet.
shipping.regions.text2: Somewhere else? Ask us on WhatsApp. If we can send it, we will tell you the cost and time first.
shipping.customs.text1: Deliveries to the United Arab Emirates and to any other destination outside the European Union may be subject to import duties or local taxes charged by the authorities there.
shipping.customs.text2: How taxes and duties are handled for each region, and who pays them: [TO BE CONFIRMED].
shipping.damaged.text1: Message us by WhatsApp on +34 622 20 99 35 as soon as you can. Include your order reference and a few photos of the item and the packaging.
shipping.damaged.text2: We will agree a solution with you in the conversation, such as a replacement or a refund. Your legal guarantee rights as a consumer are not affected by anything on this page.
shipping.returns.text1: If you are a consumer in the European Union, the law generally lets you cancel a distance purchase within a set period without giving a reason, with some exceptions. The period and conditions for our orders: [WITHDRAWAL PERIOD].
shipping.returns.text2: Return rules for customers in the United Arab Emirates and other regions: [TO BE CONFIRMED].
shipping.returns.text3: Some products may be excluded from returns once opened, for example fragrances, for hygiene reasons. The final list of exceptions: [TO BE CONFIRMED].
shipping.returns.text4: Who pays the cost of sending an item back: [TO BE CONFIRMED].
shipping.startAReturn.item1: Message us by WhatsApp on +34 622 20 99 35. Give your name, your order reference (it looks like TCD-000000-xxxx) and the item you want to return.
shipping.startAReturn.item2: Tell us the reason if you wish. For a damaged or faulty item, add photos.
shipping.startAReturn.item3: Wait for our reply. We confirm whether the return is accepted and give you the return address ([RETURN ADDRESS]) and instructions.
shipping.startAReturn.item4: Pack the item safely, unused and in its original packaging where possible, and send it as agreed. Keep the proof of postage.
shipping.startAReturn.item5: We confirm in the same conversation when the item has arrived.
shipping.startAReturn.text: Please do not send anything back before we have replied. A parcel that arrives without warning is hard to match to an order.
shipping.refunds.text1: Refunds are made using the same payment method you used, unless we agree something else with you.
shipping.refunds.text2: Time needed to issue a refund after a return is accepted: [TO BE CONFIRMED].
shipping.contact.text: Ask us anything about delivery or returns by WhatsApp on +34 622 20 99 35 or through the contact page. The formal rules are in the terms and conditions.

order.lede.processing: Your order is being made. We will e-mail you the tracking link the moment it ships.
order.lede.partially_shipped: Part of your order has shipped. The rest follows soon.
order.lede.shipped: Your order has shipped. Follow it with the tracking link below.
order.lede.delivered: Your order has been delivered. We hope it keeps a few secrets for you.
order.confirming.title: confirming your payment…
order.confirming.text: This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.
order.pending.title: this order is not paid yet.
order.pending.text: The payment was not completed, so nothing was charged. Your bag is still saved: go back to checkout to try again.
order.waiting.title: still waiting for your payment.
order.waiting.text: Your bank has not confirmed the payment yet. This can take a few minutes. You will get an e-mail as soon as it does, and you can check again here.
order.failed.title: this payment did not go through.
order.failed.text: The order expired before it was paid, and nothing was charged. Your pieces are still waiting for you.
order.cancelled.title: this order was cancelled.
order.cancelled.text: Nothing more will be shipped for this order.
order.cancelled.refundPending: Your refund is on its way.
order.notFound.title: we could not find that order.
order.notFound.text: Open the link in your confirmation e-mail again, or write to us with your order number and we will look it up.
order.error.title: we could not load your order.
order.error.text: Check your connection and try again. Your order itself is safe.
order.parcels.split: Your pieces are made in different places, so they travel in separate parcels. Each parcel has its own tracking.
order.tracking.label: Tracking:
order.summary.title: what you ordered
order.help.title: need a hand?
order.help.text: Questions about your order, the delivery or a return? Write to us on WhatsApp with your order number.
email.common.help: Questions? Write to us on WhatsApp: {whatsapp}
email.common.footer: You are receiving this e-mail because you placed an order at {site}.
email.order_confirmed.subject: Your order {id} is confirmed
email.order_confirmed.intro: Thank you. Your payment went through and we are getting your order ready.
email.order_confirmed.introCod: Thank you. Your order is confirmed. You pay the courier in cash when it arrives.
email.order_confirmed.next: We will e-mail you again with a tracking link as soon as it ships.
email.order_confirmed.split: Your pieces are made in different places, so they may arrive in separate parcels.
email.order_confirmed.madeToOrder: Personalised pieces are made only for you and cannot be returned for a change of mind.
email.shipped.subject: Your order {id} has shipped
email.shipped.intro: Good news: a parcel from your order is on its way.
email.shipped.more: The rest of your order follows in another parcel.
email.order_cancelled.subject: Your order {id} was cancelled
email.order_cancelled.intro: Your order was cancelled. If you already paid, your refund is on its way.
email.refund_issued.subject: Your refund for order {id}
email.refund_issued.intro: We have refunded {amount} to your original payment method. It can take a few days to show on your statement.
